title: Jaws
era_role: Crucial standalone single (June 2018). Serves as the bridge between the Two EP and Sundowning. Introduces the recurring motif of teeth, the bite, and romantic/sacrificial consumption.
in_character_quotes_gap_reason: Sleep Token granted very few interviews in 2016-2018 and never provided track-by-track in-character commentary.

editorial_reading.summary: Louder and Boolin Tunes identify 'Jaws' as the pivotal transition toward dark-pop/synth accessibility without sacrificing metallic weight, focusing on the dread of intimacy framed as a predatory snare.
editorial_reading.source_title: Boolin Tunes - The Lore of Sleep Token

editorial_reading.summary: Divorced from the storytelling of the first two EPS, Jaws sees Vessel beg for a seduced partner to open up emotionally. ‘Show me what you’ve lost and why you’re always taking it slow,’ he implores. ‘Show me what wounds you’ve got, show me love.’
editorial_reading.source_title: Louder - The story behind every Sleep Token song (Page 1)

editorial_reading.summary: 2018 saw Sleep Token focus more on their live shows than releasing music. Only two standalone singles were released that year - "Jaws" in June and "The Way That You Were" in October.[12] Both singles were later issued together on 10" vinyl for Record Store Day in 2021.[13]

The original logo, or sigil, is a simplified version of the current one, which made its debut on the cover art for "Hey Ya!" in February 2017. It is also used on the cover art for "Jaws" and "The Way That You Were" in 2018. Fans theorize that it may be created from the Elder Futhark alphabet, although nothing has been confirmed by the band. It was not until 2019 that the current iteration was revealed starting with Sundowning, seemingly incorporating more runes and symbols within it.[citation needed]

symbols.sigil: Dedicated glyph for the Jaws single (vertical symmetry evocative of open jaws)
symbols.creature: Abyssal predator and pretty white jaws ('pretty white jaws')
symbols.object: Open jaws, sharp teeth, and exposed wounds ('show me what wounds you've got')
symbols.ritual_role: Birth of the ritual devouring motif and surrender to feral vulnerability
symbols.depth_gap_reason: Not applicable to Chapter 0 (the 12 sigils belong to Sundowning, depths in meters/fathoms to TPWBYT, and runic alphabet to TMBTE).
symbols.rune_gap_reason: Not applicable to Chapter 0 (the 12 sigils belong to Sundowning, depths in meters/fathoms to TPWBYT, and runic alphabet to TMBTE).

references.detail: The 'pretty white jaws' unite a seductive human smile with the maw of a predator, establishing the metaphor of love as spiritual cannibalism.
references.supporting_phrase: Show me those pretty white jaws / Show me where the delicate stops

callbacks.motif: The motif of jaws and the bite ('Take a bite' in The Offering, 'jaws' in High Water, the swallowing throat in Vore) originates entirely within 'Jaws'.
callbacks.source_title: Boolin Tunes - The Lore of Sleep Token

community_theories.theory: In community lore, 'Jaws' is Vessel's plea to Sleep (or a human lover) to discard the guise of tenderness ('where the delicate stops') and expose their raw destructive essence.
